result.title: Normalizing Flows are Capable World Models
result.comment: An earlier version of this work was accepted at the Workshop on Learning Effective Abstractions for Planning (LEAP) at CoRL 2026
result.summary: A world model lets an agent anticipate the consequences of its actions and use imagined futures to make decisions. We introduce Normalizing-Flow World Model (NFWM), which pairs an invertible observation encoder with an action-conditioned probabilistic predictor. Because the encoder is invertible, the predicted distribution over latent states defines a distribution over future observations. Maximizing the exact conditional likelihood of those observations therefore trains the representation and dynamics jointly. An agent can plan directly in the learned latent space and decode sampled trajectories to inspect possible futures. On Teleport, these samples capture the two possible outcomes of the same action. In Flappy Bird, a world model trained by likelihood alone supports reward-based planning that reaches 100 pipes in all ten evaluated games. For goal-conditioned control, an auxiliary inverse-dynamics objective shapes the coordinates used to compare predicted states with a goal. On LIBERO, NFWM uses this distance to select successful action sequences more often than LeWM and SMWM. In Atari Boxing, training on imagined trajectories improves a policy beyond its behavior-cloned initialization. Together, these results establish normalizing flows as capable world models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Normalizing-Flow World Model：用可逆观测编码器搭配动作条件概率预测器，使潜状态上的预测分布可直接定义未来观测分布，并以精确条件似然联合训练表示与动力学，支持在潜空间直接规划、采样并解码未来轨迹；在目标条件控制中还引入辅助逆动力学目标来塑造潜空间比较坐标。
AI.relevance_reason: 可逆编码器保证观测可解码、精确似然联合训练表示与动力学、以及用辅助目标重塑潜空间距离，可能对 LVR 中的视觉细节保留、latent 状态监督与相似度度量内容偏移问题提供可核查线索，但其任务是控制而非多模态推理。
